column3: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy is not set: require-corp exists for SharedArrayBuffer-class features foldrun does not use, and would block legitimate cross-origin resources. COOP and CORP are set.

style-src keeps 'unsafe-inline' (28 Oct 2026): React renders style props as style="" attributes in server HTML, and a nonce covers <style> elements, never attributes (CSP3 style-src-attr). script-src is strict — a per-request nonce and 'strict-dynamic', no inline script, no eval — and that is what stops injected code running.
